name: INV-02 - Get Invoice Status
purpose: Allow Copilot Studio to retrieve invoice status by invoice number without exposing unrelated records.

trigger.action: When an agent calls the flow

actions.name: List rows
actions.notes: Escape single quotes in the normalized input, then filter cyg_invoicenumber with OData; select only invoice number, supplier, total, status, review reason, approval comments and source URL; Top Count 5.

actions.name: Build response
actions.notes: If zero matches return found=false. If one or more matches, return found=true and a compact status summary.

actions.name: Respond to the agent
actions.notes: Asynchronous response must be Off. Keep runtime comfortably under the 100-second agent action limit.
